The '''''Vigil''''' was a [[Vakbeor-class cargo frigate|''Vakbeor''-class]] [[cargo frigate]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards]]. It was captured by [[Resistance]] [[commando]]s from [[pirate]]s during a [[Battle of Chasidron Shoals|battle]] off the [[Chasidron Shoals]].<ref name="TLJICS" /> It became part of the [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]] under the command of [[Vice Admiral]] [[Jotis]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[First Order]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> It was one of four [[Starship|vessels]] that Resistance forces used on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuated]] on after they were attacked by the First Order following the [[Battle of Starkiller Base|destruction]] of [[Starkiller Base]]. It was used also to house supplies and munitions and many other types of equipment during the evacuation. After the Resistance successfully destroyed the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|First Order Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]'' above D'Qar, the ''Vigil'' jumped to [[lightspeed]] along with the<ref name="TLJ" /> [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']], the [[Anodyne (Nebulon-C)|''Anodyne'']] and the ''[[Ninka]]''.<ref name="TLJ" /><ref name="TLJVD" /> The First Order was able to [[Hyperspace tracker|track]] the Resistance [[fleet]] through lightspeed and followed them and [[Battle of Oetchi|attacking]] once they arrived at their destination, quickly destroying the ''Vigil'' as it attempted to flee.<ref name="TLJ" />
